guideUpdate.title: Navigate from the V4 launcher to Agentic AI
guideUpdate.affectedSection: Navigating the V4 launcher and opening Agentic AI
steps: Select Open on the Agentic AI module card.
Confirm that the Agentic AI module opens at /agentic-ai.
Use your browser's Back button to return to the launcher.
Confirm that the launcher returns at /launcher with its module cards available.
